# MOZ Mozambique: partial (prosecutor case files by province, 2019–2020)

Found: the Procuradoria-Geral da República's annual reports to parliament. Their PDFs are listed through the site's WordPress media data service (https://www.pgr.gov.mz/wp-json/wp/v2/media?mime_type=application/pdf), and the reports exist for 2015, 2016, 2018, 2019, 2020 and 2021. Each has an annex table "Tabela nº 1 – Crimes contra a Vida (homicídios voluntários, involuntários, linchamentos)" by Procuradoria Provincial for the 11 provinces, including Cidade de Maputo.
- The 2021 report (data year 2020) has a text table, extracted with code. It also gives "Registados 2019".
- The 2020 report (data year 2019) has the table as a rotated image. I rendered it and read it by eye. All 11 "Registados" values match the 2021 report's 2019 column, and they sum to the printed total of 2,753.

Caveats:
- These are case files at the Public Prosecutor (registered, pending, indicted, no charge, under investigation). They are not police-recorded offences or victim counts.
- The category mixes intentional homicide, involuntary homicide (most of it from road accidents) and lynching. The province tables do not split these. A national-only table in the 2021 report (Anexo, "Tipos legais de crimes") does split them, for example Homicídio voluntário simples 501 entered, Homicídio qualificado 733, Linchamento 87, Homicídio involuntário 1,177. It was not entered because it is national.
- The variation columns (absolute and %) were not entered.
- The 2019 report (data year 2018) gives only prose: "maior número … Zambézia, com 309, seguida das Províncias de Manica e Tete, com 156 e 146". No province table text was found, so it was not entered. The 2018, 2016 and 2015 reports have no extractable "Crimes contra a Vida" table text. They may hold image tables that I did not check page by page.
- No licence statement.

Not reachable: INE Moçambique (www.ine.gov.mz returned 503 or no connection), so "Estatísticas da Justiça" and the Anuário were not opened. PRM police (police.gov.mz) was unreachable. The web search budget ran out after one Mozambique query, which returned only press items.
